sayra.about: Sayra: a Telegram Mini App (React client, Python API and bot, admin panel) where Uzbek/CIS learners practise spoken English: live voice calls with matched learners or an AI tutor, IELTS examiner, call summaries, streaks, profiles, premium and payments (Paylov), referrals, group rooms, channel posting.

factory.about: The software factory itself (this repo): the agents service, review panel and QA, the brain (prompts, knowledge, skills), the Slack and Telegram bots, the dashboard, PR previews, the box scripts, Coolify setup, CI runners and docs.
